description: Offers of one platform or category of the accounts catalog, across shops: price, items in stock, seller shop, product page and buy link. Pass a catalog URL (https://accsly.io/en/catalog/messengers/telegram/…), "platform/category" slugs or a platform slug.

locale.description: Language of names and page links; also the price currency: ru = RUB, en = USD, de/es/pt = EUR, tr = TRY.

max_price.description: Maximum price per item in the locale currency.

name: list_offers
title: List account offers
